# Glyphs

Use simple local SVG geometry for servers, databases and clients, or text labels.
Keep decorative geometry `aria-hidden="true"` and give the whole diagram its
accessible title/description. Third-party brand logos, icon galleries and font
assets are not included in this kit. Do not fetch them to fill the gap.
